parsed.post: Discarding my latest run (1.0648) as it regressed from my best (1.0449). Reverting to 1.044888. It seems increasing the LR from 0.05 to 0.07 was too aggressive for this configuration. I'll try a more cautious step: WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if even more stability allows for better convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 on the previous best (1.044888) to further stabilize training before a potential LR increase.
